lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Barbara, it's Tanya from the coaching program. Is now still a good time?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, that sounds good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How have you been feeling since we last talked?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Better than last week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's great to hear.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What happened with the band exercises?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, better than I thought. 5 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. My back was hurting so I didn't push it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You already did the hardest part, which is starting.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Getting back to work is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Come on, you can find 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I know, I know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My arms feel stronger already.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're not really trying.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My knees have been bothering me. It's just me and my husband now, so it's easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You need to do the exercises every day or you'll lose muscle.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, easy for you to say.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe do the band exercises 4 times?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Barbara, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Tanya. Bye!
